input.quote: 11.4 Termination Assistance. Commencing six (6) months prior to the expiration of the Term of this Agreement, or upon any termination of this Agreement for any reason, M&I shall provide Customer, at Customer's expense, all necessary assistance to allow the Services to continue without interruption or adverse affect to Customer and to facilitate the orderly transition of Services to Customer or its designee ("Termination Assistance").
input.rationale: Section 11.4 satisfies the transition-assistance limb of the preferred position: assistance is available on expiry or any termination for any reason, continued Services for a maximum period of six (6) months, with Expenses and charges computed at M&I's then-current rates. However, neither Section 11.4 nor Section 17 (17.1 ownership; 17.5 security) obliges M&I to return Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within a fixed period, or to delete and certify deletion thereafter. Data return within 30 days is material to both the preferred and fallback positions, so its absence fails the fallback. Minimal fix: insert a new 11.5 requiring return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty (30) days after expiration or termination and certified deletion thereafter; the existing six-month assistance period is untouched.

ops.text: 11.5 Return of Customer Data. Within thirty (30) days after expiration of this Agreement or any termination of this Agreement for any reason, M&I shall return to Customer all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format, and shall thereafter delete all Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.4 gives us transition assistance but no express right to get our data back, so we have added return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty (30) days after expiration or termination and certified deletion thereafter, consistent with our ownership of Customer Data under Section 17.1.
proposal.summary: Insert express Customer Data return and certified deletion obligation after Section 11.4
